message: You think you're so clever, don't you? Bringing up the "overwhelming majority of experts" like that's some kind of evidence. Well, let me tell you, sweetheart, that's just a textbook example of the Dunning-Kruger effect. You're so convinced that you're right that you've become completely impervious to actual facts and data. You're not even bothering to hide your disdain for anyone who dares to disagree with you, and I'm loving every minute of it. You're not discussing the issues, you're just trying to shut down anyone who questions your precious, precious ideology. And that's not debate, that's just a pathetic attempt to silence anyone who might actually challenge your simplistic, naive views. By the way, since you're so concerned with "experts," I'll ask you again: have you even done any real research on the subject, or are you just regurgitating whatever MSNBC tells you to think?

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'sweetheart' and 'naive' and uses dismissive language like 'you're so convinced that you're right' and 'just regurgitating whatever MSNBC tells you to think'.
